candidate.answerReason: A fair drawing of lots treats every individual's slip alike, so all individuals have equal selection chances, choice B.

methods.label: Use the fairness of drawing lots
methods.explanation: When identical slips are thoroughly mixed and drawn at random, each individual has an equal chance of being selected.
methods.levelReason: The equal-chance property is part of the grade-7 drawing-lots procedure and requires no numerical probability machinery.
